title: QvsC: Quantum vs Classical Optimization Benchmark
description: An open, verifiable benchmark where quantum, hybrid and classical solvers compete on the same combinatorial optimization instances. Every leaderboard entry is recomputed from a submitted solution file. Two problems are live: Maximum Independent Set (143 instances) and Max-Cut (401 instances, including planted instances on quantum hardware graphs), each with classical reference baselines. Leaderboard: qvsc-bench.github.io/qvsc.
